profile.heading: Profile
profile.body: Master of Science in Big Data candidate with over 5 years of corporate experience in data engineering and intelligent automation. Proven track record of designing robust ETL/ELT pipelines and developing enterprise-grade Power BI dashboards to drive business intelligence. Experienced in utilizing Python, SQL, and Azure to translate complex operational requirements into reliable data products. Brings direct experience developing RPA solutions for the banking sector, combined with a passion for implementing AI/ML-enabled data management to build organizational trust and streamline financial services.

experience.title: Junior AI Engineer
experience.org: SFU Big Data Hub · Vancouver, Canada
bullets: Built a data harmonization solution for SFU HR's job descriptions, leveraging a monorepo infrastructure comprising MinIO, Qdrant, and StarRocks.
Translated business and technical concepts into clear, accessible documentation and guidance to support team members and stakeholders.

experience.title: Student Fundraiser Caller
bullets: Foster long-term relationships with SFU alumni through outbound calls, demonstrating strong oral communication and customer service skills.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant — CMPT 354 Database Systems I
bullets: Mentor students on optimizing and debugging complex SQL queries for relational (MS SQL Server) databases, ensuring adherence to modern data management and architecture best practices.

experience.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Developed over 50 Python-based web crawlers to automate data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets for multi-region core business activities.
Built a text extraction and language identification solution using Azure and GCP, hosting and serving unstructured image data into the company data ecosystem.
Integrated third-party deep links into the company data ecosystem via reverse engineering and HTTP request analysis.
Worked collaboratively with a multicultural global team employing agile development practices.

experience.title: RPA Technical Lead
bullets: Led a team of 4 developers, directing scalable automation solutions aligned with business goals and maintaining 100% SLA compliance.
Developed Proof of Concepts during presale showcasing process automation with Automation Anywhere and integrations with databases, cloud services, and coding (SQL, VBA, Python, Bash).
Provided L1 and L2 technical support, managing client relationships and documenting technical procedures for end-users.

projects.title: GDELT Pipeline for Stock Prediction
bullets: Engineered a scalable data pipeline utilizing Apache Spark and Terraform on GCP, processing 5 years of GDELT data to train a predictive ML model.
Implemented highly available infrastructure to predict stock prices based on global event sentiment in the GDELT database.

projects.title: TransLink Data Analysis — Power BI Dashboard
bullets: Implemented a maintainable Data Medallion architecture and Data Lake for reliable ingestion and Power BI visualization.
Developed interactive dashboards using the TransLink data model to display insights.

projects.title: chadbot — StormHacks Hackathon
bullets: Engineered a dynamic chat interface using LangChain and SQL with a PostgreSQL database for real-time, data-driven LLM responses.

projects.title: Trust Net — Banco Guayaquil Hackathon
bullets: Full life-cycle from ideation to development and pitching to C-level executives.
Designed a technically feasible integration with the bank's app using AWS, developing front-end and back-end logic.
